name: rnd-prd
description: Needs and acceptance for the R&D desk: tasks with testable criteria, backlog grooming, deliveries packaged for acceptance. / 需求与验收手册：带验收标准的任务、需求池整理、按功能整理待验收的交付。

body.en:
{target}

Follow this skill's intake steps on the text I paste: split it into tasks with outcome titles, requester and testable acceptance criteria, check for duplicates, and show me the list before writing.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

按这份手册的拆需求步骤处理我贴的内容：拆成以结果命名、写明提出人和可验证验收标准的任务，先查重，写入前先给我看清单。

label.en: Package last week's work for acceptance
label.zh-CN: 把上周的改动整理成待验收的交付

body.en:
{target}

Follow this skill's packaging steps for last Monday to Sunday: group the merged changes by what users can now do, write acceptance steps that cover every criterion, and show me the grouping before writing.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

按这份手册的整理步骤处理上周一到周日：把合并的改动按「用户现在能做到什么」归并，写出覆盖每条验收标准的验收步骤，写入前先给我看归并结果。

label.en: Check tasks and deliveries against the rules
label.zh-CN: 按规矩检查需求和交付

body.en:
{target}

Check open tasks and ready deliveries against this skill: untestable criteria, missing requesters, deliveries named after code, steps that skip a criterion. List problems with a fix for each. Do not change anything.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

按这份手册检查未完成的任务和待验收的交付：无法验证的标准、缺提出人、按代码命名的交付、漏掉标准的验收步骤。列出问题并给出改法。不要修改任何记录。

label.en: Add a new rule to the needs playbook
label.zh-CN: 把新定的规矩写进需求手册

body.en:
{target}

Fold the rule I describe into this skill's SKILL.md where it belongs, keeping the rest unchanged, and show me the diff before proposing the change.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

把我说的新规矩写进这份 SKILL.md 合适的位置，其余内容保持不变，提交变更前先给我看改动。

label.en: Explain how we write needs and accept work
label.zh-CN: 讲讲我们怎么写需求、怎么验收

body.en:
{target}

Explain this skill to a new product manager: how a need becomes a task, what good acceptance criteria look like, and how a delivery is accepted. Use one example from the desk. Do not change anything.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

给新来的产品经理讲清这份手册：需求怎么变成任务、好的验收标准长什么样、交付怎么验收。用工作台里的一个例子说明。不要修改任何记录。
